item.title: Travis Scott Was ‘Actually Nervous’ When He Shot His Scenes For ‘The Odyssey’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest edition of "Trending on Billboard"! Today, we're talking about Travis Scott, the "Sicko Mode" rapper who's been on a hot streak lately.
[Sound effects: A quick clip of "Sicko Mode" plays]
Host: You might remember that Travis Scott's Circus Maximus Tour last year raked in a whopping $265 million, making it the highest-grossing solo rap trek in history. And now, he's making waves in the acting world with his feature film debut in Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey".
[Sound effects: A quick clip of a movie theme song plays]
Host: Travis Scott plays The Bard in the film, and his performance has been well-received. But what's even more impressive is the box office results - "The Odyssey" brought in $123.5 million domestically and $263.7 million globally, making it the biggest live-action opening weekend of 2026.
[Sound effects: A quick clip of a cash register ringing up sales plays]
Host: In a recent interview on "The Tonight Show", Travis Scott admitted that he was nervous about acting in front of the all-star cast, but director Christopher Nolan made him feel comfortable and supported. And as a bonus, he even got to direct the official music video for the film's closing-credits song, "When I'm Home", which drops next week.
[Sound effects: A quick clip of a camera shutter clicking plays]
Host: And if all that wasn't enough, Travis Scott also recently met with Norway striker Erling Haaland, who wore a soccer boot designed by Scott in a tournament. Haaland even gave Scott a signed jersey as a thank you gift.
[Sound effects: A quick clip of a soccer crowd cheering plays]
Host: That's all for today's edition of "Trending on Billboard". Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
[Outro music plays]
